name: A Recipe For Death
summary: Apothecary Renferrel sends you to gather rare reagents across Lake Lordamere. Berard's journal names mosses and a strange tumor, which you bring to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity. The Royal Apothecary Society needs them for its work on a New Plague.

sections.title: A Legacy of Research
sections.body: Apothecary Berard's death under Arugal's curse cost the Royal Apothecary Society a skilled researcher. His field journal survived, preserving what he learned about blighted life in Silverpine Forest and Lake Lordamere. At the Sepulcher, Apothecary Renferrel studied the recovered notes and found Berard's account of promising properties in local freshwater organisms. Now Renferrel asks you to carry forward the work his colleague began.

sections.title: The Hazards of Lake Lordamere
sections.body: Berard's reagents lie among the Dawning Isles, mist-shrouded islands in the eastern waters of Lake Lordamere. Lake skulkers and lake creepers on the isles carry peculiar moss strains that live in tainted water. Berard also noted a hardened tumor among the fierce Vile Fin murloc tribes that nest along the islets and the lake's southern shoreline near Ambermill.

sections.title: Fueling the Apothecarium
sections.body: Master Apothecary Faranell receives the specimens at the Apothecarium in the Undercity, bypassing the Sepulcher. He considers these strange mutations essential to making a New Plague that can destroy the Scourge and the living. Berard's research now feeds the Society's work in its cauldron vats, bringing the Forsaken closer to their weapon.

faq.q: Why does the Royal Apothecary Society need moss and a tumor?
faq.answer: Apothecary Berard's field journal describes unusual properties in the aquatic mosses found on lake beasts and the hardened tumors growing on local Vile Fin murlocs. Master Apothecary Faranell uses these rare, altered materials to brew and refine the Royal Apothecary Society's New Plague.

Apothecary Berard researched for the Royal Apothecary Society in Silverpine Forest. Arugal's curse made him a mindless servant, but his recovered field journal gave Apothecary Renferrel and Master Apothecary Faranell the reagent details needed to carry on his work.

faq.q: Where are the Dawning Isles located?
faq.answer: The Dawning Isles are small islands in eastern Lake Lordamere, just east of Silverpine Forest. Lake skulkers, lake creepers, and hostile Vile Fin murloc tribes infest them.

Master Apothecary Faranell leads the Royal Apothecary Society from deep within the Apothecarium in the Undercity. He oversees research into chemical warfare and biological concoctions, as well as the creation of the New Plague for Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.

faq.q: Why are Vile Fin murlocs growing hardened tumors?
faq.answer: Blighted decay and nearby arcane conflicts have warped Lake Lordamere's waters and shores. Hardened tumors on the Vile Fin are rare, abnormal growths from this contaminated environment, and the Forsaken prize them for study.

faq.q: How does this quest connect to the New Plague?
faq.answer: The Recipe for Death chain gathers ingredients for the New Plague. Junior apothecaries such as Renferrel decipher and collect regional materials, then send them to Faranell's plague-brewing work in the Undercity.

angles.text: As an Undead, carrying on Berard's unfinished experiments serves the Dark Lady's vision. Every Forsaken mind helps the nation survive, even in death.
As a member of the Horde, you can help Forsaken apothecaries gather reagents for their New Plague.
